title: Navigating Sparse Evidence: Agentic Visual RAG via Explicit Context Selection and Consolidation
mechanism: Add an explicit evidence-ledger step to chitta's multi-hop recall/agent loop: during exploration (multi-turn recall_smart/hybrid_recall calls, long_task sessions), append only query-relevant hits plus their source pointers (memory/triplet IDs) to a running textual ledger instead of relying on raw RRF-merged trajectory dumps; at turn/task termination, reload the pointed-to original memories and re-order them into an explicit evidence block that is handed to answer generation separately from exploration noise.

expected_gain.rationale: chitta already does single-shot hybrid RRF+rerank retrieval (chitta-mcp/server.py handle_recall_gateway) but has no cross-turn evidence ledger with source-pointer consolidation before final answer synthesis, so sparse/dispersed multi-hop evidence across sessions can still get diluted by exploration noise even after reranking.

cost.scope: hooks/prompt-core.sh (agent-loop wiring), chitta-mcp/server.py handle_recall_gateway/handle_recall_smart, chitta/src/handlers/field_memory_recall.cpp (source-pointer retrieval), benchmarks/longmemeval harness for eval

evidence.claim: Paper: SCoRE retains only query-relevant observations and their source pointers in a maintained textual ledger during exploration, preserving earlier evidence while keeping visual context bounded.
Paper: at termination SCoRE reloads referenced original images and consolidates evidence into a logical sequence before answering, decoupling final reasoning from exploratory trial-and-error.
